description: This Java source file defines the HibernateOrderDAO class, an implementation of the OrderDAO interface for managing Order-related database operations within the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It contains methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting Orders, OrderGroups, and related entities. The class utilizes Hibernate ORM and JPA Criteria API for data access, and it handles complex queries and data integrity checks across various Order-related entities. It is part of the OpenMRS core API's persistence layer for order management.

classes.name: HibernateOrderDAO
classes.description: Implementation of the OrderDAO interface for managing Order-related database interactions in OpenMRS. Provides methods for CRUD operations, complex queries, and utility functions for Orders, OrderGroups, and related entities using Hibernate ORM and JPA criteria API.

methods.name: saveOrder
methods.description: Saves or updates an Order entity in the database.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Deletes the specified Order entity from the database.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an Order by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches a list of Orders filtered by order type, patients, concepts, orderers, and encounters.

methods.name: getOrders (OrderSearchCriteria)
methods.description: Retrieves Orders based on detailed search criteria encapsulated in an OrderSearchCriteria object.

methods.name: getOrderByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an Order by its UUID.

methods.name: getDiscontinuationOrder
methods.description: Fetches the discontinuation Order associated with a given Order.

methods.name: getRevisionOrder
methods.description: Fetches the revision Order linked to a specified Order.

methods.name: getOrderFromDatabase
methods.description: Executes a raw SQL query to retrieve order details from the database, optionally including drug order details.

methods.name: deleteObsThatReference

methods.name: getOrderByOrderNumber

methods.name: getNextOrderNumberSeedSequenceValue

methods.name: getActiveOrders
